name: PixelPulse Gaming
description: Level up your game with PixelPulse.
story: PixelPulse Gaming is a Hong Kong-based esports and gaming hardware company dedicated to providing accessible and high-performance peripherals for gamers of all skill levels. We see motorsport as the ultimate arena for precision and performance, mirroring the values we instill in our products. We're eager to support rising talent and gain exposure within a passionate, tech-savvy audience.
